sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It's indeed a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: It is my honor and pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸和快乐。

sentences.en: A pleasure for me to introduce
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能介绍

sentences.en: the next president of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 下一任美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: Today, what the 2020 presidential campaign sounds like.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来听听2020年总统竞选的声音。

sentences.en: Politics reporter Astead Harndam on what we can learn about the state of the race from the candidates' playlists.
sentences.zh: 政治记者阿斯特德·赫恩丹将通过候选人的播放列表，带我们了解这场竞选的现状。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月22日，星期四。

sentences.en: I said there are, of course, so many ways to think about a campaign and analyze it and break it down.
sentences.zh: 我说过，思考、分析和剖析一场竞选活动的方法当然有很多。

sentences.en: So why did you decide to zero in on music?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么决定把重点放在音乐上呢？

sentences.en: When we think about political campaigns, essentially they are stories.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到政治竞选时，本质上它们就是故事。

sentences.en: And the candidates are trying to tell the public a story about themselves and about what they can provide to that voter's life.
sentences.zh: 候选人试图向公众讲述关于他们自己以及他们能为选民生活带来什么的故事。

sentences.en: And they do that in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 他们通过很多方式做到这一点。

sentences.en: They do that through policies.
sentences.zh: 他们通过政策来实现。

sentences.en: They do that by touting their experience.
sentences.zh: 他们通过宣扬自己的经验来实现。

sentences.en: But they also do that by trying to evoke a certain emotion, and that often has happened through music.
sentences.zh: 但他们也通过试图唤起某种情感来实现，而这通常是通过音乐发生的。

sentences.en: All the way back in the 50s, you had Dwight Eisenhower with a jingle about We Like Ike.
sentences.zh: 早在50年代，德怀特·艾森豪威尔就有一首关于“我们喜欢艾克”的广告歌。

sentences.en: If you think to the 60s, you have Kennedy Can.
sentences.zh: 如果你想到60年代，就会有“肯尼迪能行”。

sentences.en: And these campaigns were having jingles not just to literally have the voters remember their names, but they would have stories
sentences.zh: 这些竞选活动使用广告歌不仅是为了让选民记住他们的名字，而且歌词里还有故事，

sentences.en: in them to evoke a certain emotion that would track with the kind of message that the campaign was trying to send.
sentences.zh: 旨在唤起某种与竞选活动试图传达的信息相契合的情感。

sentences.en: Do you want a man for president who's seasoned through and through?
sentences.zh: 你想要一位经验丰富的总统吗？

sentences.en: But that's a doggone season that he won't try something new.
sentences.zh: 但他却是个老顽固，不愿尝试新事物。

sentences.en: A man who's old enough to know.
sentences.zh: 一个足够成熟的人。

sentences.en: And young enough to do.
sentences.zh: 且足够年轻去有所作为。

sentences.en: Well, it's up to you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这取决于你。

sentences.en: It's up to you.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你。

sentences.en: It's strictly up to you.
sentences.zh: 完全取决于你。

sentences.en: I mean, when we think back about the Kennedy, it is that Camelot, youthful, generational change feeling that we still think about.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我们回想起肯尼迪时，那种卡米洛特式的、年轻的、代际变革的感觉，我们至今仍记忆犹新。

sentences.en: And that was a clear strategy from that campaign to take what could have been a negative and spin it into a positive argument.
sentences.zh: 这是该竞选团队的一项明确策略，将可能成为负面的因素转化为积极的论点。

sentences.en: And that happens through the song, too.
sentences.zh: 而这也可以通过歌曲来实现。

sentences.en: And what we see with Eisenhower and Kennedy continues on.
sentences.zh: 我们在艾森豪威尔和肯尼迪身上看到的，一直延续至今。

sentences.en: Hello, Lyndon.
sentences.zh: 你好，林登。

sentences.en: Well, hello, Lyndon.
sentences.zh: 你好，林登。

sentences.en: You have Lyndon Johnson, who uses a popular song from the time, Hello, Dolly, and spins it into Hello, Lyndon.
sentences.zh: 林登·约翰逊使用了当时流行的一首歌《你好，多莉》，并将其改编为《你好，林登》。

sentences.en: You have Jimmy Carter with a more kind of mellow Collie song.
sentences.zh: 吉米·卡特则用了一首比较柔和的歌曲。

sentences.en: I heard a young man speaking out just the other day.
sentences.zh: 前几天我听到一个年轻人大声疾呼。

sentences.en: So I stopped to take a listen to what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 所以我停下来听听他要说什么。

sentences.en: That talks about him being straight and simple and can fix government and the kind of can-do attitude that we have come to know Jimmy Carter to this day.
sentences.zh: 这谈到了他为人正直、简单，能够修复政府，以及我们至今所熟知的吉米·卡特那种“能行”的态度。

sentences.en: And these are, again, intentional choices of campaigns to quite literally write a song that
sentences.zh: 这些再次证明，竞选团队是有意为之，他们确实写了一首歌，

sentences.en: puts the themes that they are trying to evoke to a jingle that sticks in the public's mind, but also can reshape the way they view a particular candidate.
sentences.zh: 将他们试图唤起的主题融入到一首朗朗上口的广告歌中，这不仅能留在公众心中，还能重塑他们对特定候选人的看法。

sentences.en: It's a framing device.
sentences.zh: 这是一种框架手段。

sentences.en: But as we get closer and closer to the modern era, you see the modern campaigns start to fuse
sentences.zh: 但随着我们越来越接近现代，你会看到现代竞选活动开始融合

sentences.en: politics and culture in a way where even the political campaigns themselves somewhat seem like cultural phenomenons.
sentences.zh: 政治和文化，以至于政治竞选本身看起来就像一种文化现象。

sentences.en: You have Bill Clinton on the Arsenio Hall show playing the saxophone in a kind of memorable moment.
sentences.zh: 比尔·克林顿在阿塞尼奥·霍尔秀上吹奏萨克斯风，那是一个令人难忘的时刻。

sentences.en: And it ends up with Obama, who, more than anything, his rise to the White
sentences.zh: 最终到了奥巴马，他入主白宫的过程，

sentences.en: House, his historic rise, was not only one that was political, but was a big cultural moment that saw
sentences.zh: 他那历史性的崛起，不仅是政治上的，更是一个巨大的文化时刻，

sentences.en: Hollywood and music and politics all seem for a second to blend into one.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞、音乐和政治似乎在瞬间融为一体。

sentences.en: Please give it up for Mr. Stevie Wonder.
sentences.zh: 请为史蒂夫·汪达先生鼓掌。

sentences.en: And why does that end up working for Obama?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对奥巴马有效呢？

sentences.en: Well, there was a sense that he was a kind of person of culture and that this was authentic to his
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们觉得他是一个有文化修养的人，这与他的

sentences.en: personality and to what he listened to and from the communities in which he comes from.
sentences.zh: 个性和他所听的音乐，以及他所来自的社区是真实契合的。

sentences.en: I think that's an important point.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个重要的观点。

sentences.en: The merging of kind of your political identity and a cultural identity only works if the public thinks it's an authentic thing.
sentences.zh: 将政治身份和文化身份融合，只有在公众认为它是真实的情况下才有效。

sentences.en: So it's kind of risky when we think about even a couple years ago with Hillary Clinton was running for president.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们回想几年前希拉里·克林顿竞选总统时，这其实是有风险的。

sentences.en: There was this massive derision when she tried to do kind of modern dance moves like the whip and the nay-nay.
sentences.zh: 当她试图做一些像“Whip and Nae Nae”这样的现代舞蹈动作时，遭到了巨大的嘲讽。

sentences.en: I remember still talking to
sentences.zh: 我还记得当时在和

sentences.en: Black voters.
sentences.zh: 黑人选民交谈。

sentences.en: I was out in Baltimore and they bring that up as a sign that Democrats were pandering to
sentences.zh: 我在巴尔的摩，他们提起这件事，认为这是民主党人在迎合

sentences.en: Black voters and not necessarily doing an explicit reach out.
sentences.zh: 黑人选民，而不是真正地进行明确的接触。

sentences.en: Now, Barack Obama did dance moves all the time.
sentences.zh: 现在，巴拉克·奥巴马经常跳舞。

sentences.en: The difference between one candidate and the other is the feeling that is authentic to themselves and that it is something that you can really believe coming from them.
sentences.zh: 两位候选人之间的区别在于，人们是否觉得这对他本人来说是真实的，是否觉得这是真正出自他们内心的东西。

sentences.en: Which I think brings us to today.
sentences.zh: 我想这把我们带到了今天。

sentences.en: So as you started to compile this music for the 2020 candidates, how are you thinking about the role of music in this particular campaign, 2020?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你开始为2020年候选人整理这些音乐时，你是如何看待音乐在2020年这场特定竞选中的作用的？

sentences.en: If Barack Obama cemented the merging of politics and culture, Donald Trump has exploded it.
sentences.zh: 如果说巴拉克·奥巴马巩固了政治与文化的融合，那么唐纳德·特朗普则将其引爆了。

sentences.en: This is a president who was a cultural figure long before he was a political one.
sentences.zh: 这位总统在成为政治人物之前，早就已经是文化名人了。

sentences.en: And his campaign style for anyone who has been to those rallies is so tied in to a kind of cultural phenomenon that
sentences.zh: 对于任何参加过他集会的人来说，他的竞选风格与某种文化现象紧密相连，

sentences.en: sometimes looks more like a concert or a megachurch worship experience rather than a traditional political rally.
sentences.zh: 有时看起来更像是一场音乐会或大型教会的敬拜体验，而不是传统的政治集会。

sentences.en: And so what I wanted to do was say, knowing that they are eventually going to go up against such energy on the Republican side, are Democrats doing anything differently?
sentences.zh: 所以我想要做的是，既然知道他们最终要面对共和党方面如此强大的能量，民主党人是否在做些不同的事情？

sentences.en: What does authenticity mean to these candidates?
sentences.zh: 对这些候选人来说，真实性意味着什么？

sentences.en: And particularly in such a diverse field, does it look differently from one candidate to the other?
sentences.zh: 特别是在这样一个多元化的领域，候选人之间看起来会有所不同吗？

sentences.en: Okay, so let's dive into those playlists.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们深入探讨这些播放列表。

sentences.en: Where should we start on the Democratic side in the 2020 field?
sentences.zh: 在2020年竞选的民主党阵营中，我们应该从哪里开始？

sentences.en: Let's start with Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 让我们从伯尼·桑德斯开始。

sentences.en: Brooklyn, give a hometown welcome to the man that has been speaking truth to power for generations, the next president of the United States of America, Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林，请用家乡的热情欢迎这位几十年来一直向权势说真话的人，下一任美利坚合众国总统，伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: Let's go!
sentences.zh: 开始吧！

sentences.en: Obviously, he was coming into this race off the strength of a 2016 race.
sentences.zh: 显然，他是带着2016年竞选的势头进入这场比赛的。

sentences.en: But we knew that going in here, he wanted to tell more personal stories, and he wanted to lean in to his quote-unquote political revolution.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，他进入这里时，想要讲述更多个人故事，并想要倾向于他所谓的“政治革命”。

sentences.en: That comes out in the songs.
sentences.zh: 这体现在歌曲中。

sentences.en: At his first rally in Brooklyn, he comes up to Brooklyn, go hard.
sentences.zh: 在他布鲁克林的第一场集会上，他出场时播放了《Brooklyn, Go Hard》。

sentences.en: He talks more about his upbringing in that community.
sentences.zh: 他更多地谈论他在那个社区的成长经历。

sentences.en: But then when you look through the list, all his other songs have that kind of revolution theme.
sentences.zh: 但当你查看列表时，他所有的其他歌曲都有那种革命的主题。

sentences.en: So you have things like make a change.
sentences.zh: 所以你有像《Make a Change》这样的歌。

sentences.en: Make a change.
sentences.zh: 做出改变。

sentences.en: And make it for the better.
sentences.zh: 让它变得更好。

sentences.en: Songs like Power to the People and Take It to the Streets.
sentences.zh: 还有像《Power to the People》和《Take It to the Streets》这样的歌。

sentences.en: So Sanders' musical selection is a very on-the-nose articulation of his central message of
sentences.zh: 所以桑德斯的音乐选择非常直白地表达了他关于

sentences.en: disrupting the economic and political order, and is not necessarily about broadening his message through music.
sentences.zh: 打破经济和政治秩序的核心信息，而不一定是为了通过音乐来扩大他的信息传播。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that's exactly why folks love him, is because he has been the same person.
sentences.zh: 但这正是人们喜欢他的原因，因为他始终如一。

sentences.en: And that, to people, gives them a sense of this is his real authentic self.
sentences.zh: 对人们来说，这让他们感觉到这就是他真实的一面。

sentences.en: In that same vein, just as Senator Sanders is owning his kind of political reputation through the playlist, so are some of the other presidential candidates.
sentences.zh: 同样地，正如桑德斯参议员通过播放列表展现他的政治声誉一样，其他一些总统候选人也是如此。

sentences.en: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, who has struggled to break out of the race, but has really leaned into kind of an openly feminist presidential campaign,
sentences.zh: 克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德参议员，她在竞选中挣扎着突围，但确实倾向于一种公开的女权主义总统竞选活动，

sentences.en: her playlist really reflects that also.
sentences.zh: 她的播放列表也确实反映了这一点。

sentences.en: You have songs like Woman by Kesha,
sentences.zh: 你有凯莎的《Woman》，

sentences.en: No Scrubs by TLC,
sentences.zh: TLC的《No Scrubs》，

sentences.en: Ladies First by Queen Latifah,
sentences.zh: 奎恩·拉提法的《Ladies First》，

sentences.en: Beyonce's Run the World.
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝的《Run the World》。

sentences.en: These are songs that match what she's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 这些歌曲与她试图做的事情相匹配。

sentences.en: Mayor Pete Buttigieg is another one who the words and the sounds match.
sentences.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格市长是另一个言行一致的人。

sentences.en: He has kind of broken out of this race because of his unifying message.
sentences.zh: 他因为团结的信息而在竞选中脱颖而出。

sentences.en: And more so than any other playlist, his playlist takes little bits and pieces from everywhere.
sentences.zh: 而且比任何其他播放列表都更特别的是，他的列表从各个地方汲取了点点滴滴。

sentences.en: So you have American Crazy by Brothers Osborne, But you also have American Boy by Estelle and Kanye West,
sentences.zh: 所以你有奥斯本兄弟的《American Crazy》，但也有埃斯特尔和坎耶·韦斯特的《American Boy》，

sentences.en: Confident by Demi Lovato.
sentences.zh: 黛米·洛瓦托的《Confident》。

sentences.en: You know, more modern songs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，更现代的歌曲。

sentences.en: So while Sanders and Gillibrand have a very specific theme throughout, Buttigieg's can jump into different genres, different demographics, just like his rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然桑德斯和吉利布兰德始终有非常明确的主题，但布蒂吉格的列表可以跳跃到不同的流派、不同的人群，就像他的演讲一样。

sentences.en: But it's also interesting how they use particular songs.
sentences.zh: 但他们如何使用特定的歌曲也很有趣。

sentences.en: Senator Elizabeth Warren usually walks up to Nine to Five by Dolly Parton.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦参议员通常伴随着多莉·帕顿的《Nine to Five》出场。

sentences.en: The kind of classic working class song about, you know, it's all taken and no given, the tough person's life of middle class working America that fits with her populist themes.
sentences.zh: 这是一首经典的工人阶级歌曲，关于“付出多回报少”，关于美国中产阶级劳动者艰苦的生活，这与她的民粹主义主题相契合。

sentences.en: It's about reclaiming a kind of identity and a dignity of work.
sentences.zh: 这是关于重申一种身份和工作的尊严。

sentences.en: When she's in the South, though, that song changed.
sentences.zh: 然而，当她在南方时，那首歌就变了。

sentences.en: I was with her during her kind of first Southern tour through majority Black communities in Tennessee and Georgia and Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 我在她第一次南方巡回演讲时陪同她，经过田纳西州、佐治亚州和密西西比州的黑人社区。

sentences.en: And during that tour, it was not Dolly Parton that was greeting Senator Warren as she came onto the stage, but Aretha Franklin and her song, Respect.
sentences.zh: 在那次巡回中，迎接沃伦参议员走上舞台的不是多莉·帕顿，而是艾瑞莎·弗兰克林的歌曲《Respect》。

sentences.en: Oh, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，那很有趣。

sentences.en: Yeah, another song of similar themes, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，另一首主题相似的歌，对吧？

sentences.en: We are still talking about kind of working class dignity.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然在谈论工人阶级的尊严。

sentences.en: We're still talking about women's empowerment and kind of reclaiming that.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然在谈论女性赋权和重申这一点。

sentences.en: But of course,
sentences.zh: 但当然，

sentences.en: Aretha Franklin means something different.
sentences.zh: 艾瑞莎·弗兰克林意味着不同的东西。

sentences.en: And I don't think it's an accident that when she's in those communities that that song was chosen.
sentences.zh: 我不认为当她在那些社区时选择那首歌是偶然的。

sentences.en: But what do you make of that very intentional targeting?
sentences.zh: 但你如何看待这种非常有针对性的做法？

sentences.en: I think that's politics.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是政治。

sentences.en: I think there is a kind of cynical view that says that that is pandering to an audience.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一种愤世嫉俗的观点认为，那是在迎合观众。

sentences.en: Certainly, those things can come off inauthentic if they do not feel like they are tied to a candidate or something a candidate would do.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果这些事情看起来与候选人无关，或者不是候选人会做的事情，它们可能会显得不真实。

sentences.en: If Elizabeth Warren was in the South and started playing Outkast, the Southern rap group, that would feel different.
sentences.zh: 如果伊丽莎白·沃伦在南方开始播放南方说唱组合Outkast的歌，那感觉就会不同。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why would that be different?
sentences.zh: 为什么那会有所不同？

sentences.en: And it sounds like perhaps a little problematic.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能有点问题。

sentences.en: Well, because, I mean, we keep going back to this point about does it feel true to that individual's identity?
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为，我的意思是，我们一直在回到这个观点：这是否符合那个人的真实身份？

sentences.en: I, in all the time I've spent looking, you know, talking to Senator Warren and seeing her at rallies, she's never struck me as someone who's been listening to OutkaSt.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间观察，你知道，和沃伦参议员交谈，在集会上看到她，她从来没有给过我那种听Outkast的人的感觉。

sentences.en: She is someone who listens to and cares about Aretha Franklin.
sentences.zh: 她是一个听艾瑞莎·弗兰克林并关心她的人。

sentences.en: So you can do the kind of messaging, you can do kind of intentional targeting without it being pandering, if it seems within that candidate's personality.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以进行那种信息传递，你可以进行那种有针对性的定位，而不会显得是在迎合，只要它看起来在候选人的个性范围内。

sentences.en: And so I think that is the tightrope that these campaigns are trying to walk.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这就是这些竞选团队试图走的钢丝。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: So we see Warren and Sanders playing music that gives very direct voice to their larger campaign messages, but that also seems plausibly like the music they have in their
sentences.zh: 我们看到沃伦和桑德斯播放的音乐，直接表达了他们竞选活动的核心诉求，但这些音乐听起来也确实像是他们生活中

sentences.en: lives and that they would listen to.
sentences.zh: 会听的音乐。

sentences.en: Because what they're up to here is trying to seem real and consistent and authentic.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在这里所做的，是试图展现真实、一致和地道的自我。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They are trying to match what the people coming to that rally think of them.
sentences.zh: 他们试图迎合那些参加集会的人对他们的印象。

sentences.en: Sometimes that leans into a political message, but sometimes that leans into your identity and centering that piece
sentences.zh: 有时这倾向于政治信息，但有时这倾向于你的身份认同，并将这一部分作为核心

sentences.en: throughout your campaign, throughout your rallies, and throughout your playliSt. Take Senator Kamala
sentences.zh: 贯穿于你的整个竞选活动、集会以及播放列表中。以卡玛拉·哈里斯参议员为例。

sentences.en: Harris.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯。

sentences.en: Her playlist has only one white artist and is overwhelmingly a mix of genres.
sentences.zh: 她的播放列表中只有一位白人艺术家，而且曲风极其多元。

sentences.en: It's Humble by
sentences.zh: 有肯德里克·拉马尔的

sentences.en: Kendrick Lamar.
sentences.zh: 肯德里克·拉马尔。

sentences.en: It's T-Shirt by Migos.
sentences.zh: 有Migos的《T-Shirt》。

sentences.en: It's also R&B hits.
sentences.zh: 还有R&B金曲。

sentences.en: Video from India R.
sentences.zh: 来自India Arie的视频。

sentences.en: Ree.
sentences.zh: Ree。

sentences.en: Sometimes I shave my legs and sometimes I don't.
sentences.zh: 有时我刮腿毛，有时我不刮。

sentences.en: Sometimes I comb my hair and sometimes I won't.
sentences.zh: 有时我梳头，有时我不梳。

sentences.en: Or older classics.
sentences.zh: 或者老派经典。

sentences.en: Cold Sweat by James Brown.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·布朗的《Cold Sweat》。

sentences.en: I don't care about your paSt. I don't think it's an accident that this is overwhelmingly Black artists.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎你的过去。我认为这绝非偶然，因为这里绝大多数都是黑人艺术家。

sentences.en: She is trying to tell a story about authenticity that's not based in policy, but is in what you would think a cool middle-aged Black woman would listen to.
sentences.zh: 她试图讲述一个关于真实性的故事，这并非基于政策，而是基于你认为一位酷酷的中年黑人女性会听什么。

sentences.en: So to the degree that music ever tells you what's going on in a campaign, this playlist suggests what
sentences.zh: 因此，在音乐能在多大程度上反映竞选动态的层面上，这个播放列表暗示了

sentences.en: about the decisions that the Kamala Harris campaign has made about how to represent itself.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯竞选团队在如何塑造自身形象方面所做的决定。

sentences.en: If you listen to how Kamala Harris talks about change, sometimes it's pretty explicitly around identity.
sentences.zh: 如果你听听卡玛拉·哈里斯谈论变革的方式，有时它非常明确地围绕着身份认同。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, South Carolina NAACP for honoring me with this evening.
sentences.zh: 感谢南卡罗来纳州全国有色人种协进会今晚授予我的荣誉。

sentences.en: I was in South Carolina as she told the audience of Black working-class folks.
sentences.zh: 正如她对现场的黑人工薪阶层听众所说，我当时就在南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: It matters who's in those rooms where the decisions are being made.
sentences.zh: 谁在那些做出决策的房间里，这很重要。

sentences.en: It matters.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: It matters that someone had experiences like us and that us is intentional.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，有人拥有和我们一样的经历，而这种“我们”是有意为之的。

sentences.en: It's trying to show a level of kinship with not only an important voting bloc, but a voting bloc that's felt historically ignored.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是在向一个重要的投票群体展示亲近感，也是在向一个历史上感到被忽视的投票群体示好。

sentences.en: We always have to be in those rooms, especially and even when there aren't many like us there.
sentences.zh: 我们必须始终出现在那些房间里，尤其是在那里没有多少像我们这样的人的时候。

sentences.en: That is a story about representation that her campaign is trying to tell.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的竞选团队试图讲述的关于代表性的故事。

sentences.en: And that's a story that comes through with the artist choice and the song choice.
sentences.zh: 而这个故事通过艺术家和歌曲的选择传达了出来。

sentences.en: I wonder if you can interpret Harris's musical selections as putting her identity in the foreground
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你是否可以将哈里斯的音乐选择解读为将她的身份置于首位，

sentences.en: and saying or recognizing that that may be as important, if not more important, than her
sentences.zh: 并承认这可能与她的实际政策立场一样重要，甚至更重要，

sentences.en: actual policy positions, which have occasionally confused people when she's gone back and forth on issues like Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 因为她在“全民医保”等问题上的反复立场有时会让选民感到困惑。

sentences.en: The Harris campaign thinks that people want not only someone who can deliver on policy, but they also think people are looking for a figure who can be Trump and a figure who stands
sentences.zh: 哈里斯竞选团队认为，人们不仅需要一个能落实政策的人，他们还认为人们在寻找一个能击败特朗普的人物，一个代表

sentences.en: for everything that Trump is not.
sentences.zh: 特朗普所不代表的一切的人物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And someone like Harris can have policies that might seem too far to the left or too moderate
sentences.zh: 像哈里斯这样的人，其政策对某些选民来说可能显得过于激进或过于温和，

sentences.en: for some voters, but they'll have faith in her if they believe she's authentically herself.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们相信她是真实地做自己，他们就会信任她。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The biggest example of this is the last election.
sentences.zh: 最好的例子就是上一次选举。

sentences.en: I mean, Donald Trump was not where most Republicans were on particular policy issues.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，唐纳德·特朗普在某些具体政策问题上的立场与大多数共和党人并不一致。

sentences.en: What he did have, though, was a sense that he was going through that campaign being himself.
sentences.zh: 但他拥有的，是一种他在竞选过程中始终做自己的感觉。

sentences.en: The most repeated thing you would hear on the trail was that he was himself and that Hillary Clinton was inauthentic.
sentences.zh: 你在竞选活动中最常听到的话就是他是在做自己，而希拉里·克林顿则不够真实。

sentences.en: The fairness of that is a whole separate question.
sentences.zh: 这是否公平是另一个问题。

sentences.en: But that's the lesson from 2016.
sentences.zh: 但这就是2016年留下的教训。

sentences.en: Voters will come to you if they think who you are is true to what you believe in.
sentences.zh: 如果选民认为你的为人忠于你的信仰，他们就会支持你。

sentences.en: So that brings us to the Democratic frontrunner, who we haven't mentioned yet, and his musical taste, which is Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了我们尚未提及的民主党领跑者，以及他的音乐品味，那就是乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Joe Biden has been doing this a while, right?
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登从事这一行已经很久了，对吧？

sentences.en: And he is someone who's not only run for president twice before, but has, you know, kind of been on the scene since 72.
sentences.zh: 他不仅之前两次竞选过总统，而且你知道，他从72年起就活跃在政坛了。

sentences.en: What he has now that he's never had in those previous runs is the weight of the vice presidency and genuine support from Black voters.
sentences.zh: 他现在拥有的、而之前竞选时从未拥有过的，是副总统的身份分量以及来自黑人选民的真诚支持。

sentences.en: And when you look at Biden's playlist, it merges those two views of him, the kind of
sentences.zh: 当你查看拜登的播放列表时，它融合了他那两种形象，一种是他长期以来享有的

sentences.en: working class Joe view that he has long enjoyed as a reputation, but also this new Joe Biden that we
sentences.zh: “工薪阶层乔”的声誉，另一种是我们现在看到的这个全新的乔·拜登，

sentences.en: have now, which has real and deep relationships in Black communities and widespread support across
sentences.zh: 他在黑人社区拥有真实而深厚的关系，并在整个黑人社区拥有广泛的支持。

sentences.en: Black communities.
sentences.zh: 他的播放列表几乎是五五开，在黑人和白人艺术家之间均匀分配。

sentences.en: His playlist is almost 50-50, evenly split between Black and white.
sentences.zh: 你会听到史提夫·汪达的《All I Do》、戴安娜·罗斯的《I'm Coming Out》或山姆·库克的《Good Times》。

sentences.en: You'll hear All I Do by Stevie Wonder, I'm Coming Out by Diana Ross, or Good Times by Sam Cooke.
sentences.zh: 但你也会听到大卫·鲍伊的《Heroes》、布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀的《We Take Care of Our Own》，

sentences.en: But you'll also hear Heroes by David Bowie, We Take Care of Our Own by Bruce Springsteen,
sentences.zh: 或是像Head and the Heart乐队的《All We Ever Knew》这样的现代作品。

sentences.en: or modern stuff like All We Ever Knew by Head in the Heart.
sentences.zh: 当我清晨醒来，我放眼望去，什么也看不见，只有绵延数英里的荒野。

sentences.en: When I wake up in the morning, I see nothing for miles and miles and miles.
sentences.zh: 这是一种流派的混合，但你几乎可以感觉到它在黑人和白人音乐之间交替。

sentences.en: It's a mix of genres, but you almost have it alternating between Black and white.
sentences.zh: 当我想到在南卡罗来纳州他竞选活动的早期站点之一见到他时，他甚至更进一步。

sentences.en: And when I think about when I saw him in South Carolina during one of his first campaign stops, he took this even a step further.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是播放列表在响，在他登台之前，有黑人唱诗班表演，有黑人鼓乐队表演，这是一种基于社区的活动。

sentences.en: It wasn't just that the playlist was on, but before he took the stage, a Black choir performed, a Black drumline performed, it was a kind of community-based event.
sentences.zh: 这很有效。

sentences.en: It works.
sentences.zh: 看起来他把南卡罗来纳州带到了集会现场。

sentences.en: It seems like he is bringing South Carolina to the rally.
sentences.zh: 这就是政治，那种叙事方式。

sentences.en: And that is what politics is, that type of storytelling.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否是理解为什么拜登是领跑者的一种小方式。

sentences.en: I wonder if that's one perhaps small way to understand why Biden is the frontrunner here.
sentences.zh: 我一直在思考，是什么让乔·拜登区别于其他许多候选人，他们也曾将自己标榜为某种工薪阶层、

sentences.en: I always think about what makes Joe Biden different from a bunch of other candidates who have also pitched themselves as kind of working-class,
sentences.zh: 可当选的候选人，能够与所谓的“白人中西部选民”对话。

sentences.en: electable candidates who can speak to the quote-unquote white Midwestern voter.
sentences.zh: 而让他与众不同的，是来自黑人的支持。

sentences.en: And the thing that makes him different is support from Black people.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他在民调中领先，而其他人落后的原因。

sentences.en: It's why he's ahead in the poll and why others are behind.
sentences.zh: 相反，我知道我们一直在谈论这场竞选的民主党方面。

sentences.en: And instead, I know we've been talking about the Democratic side of this campaign.
sentences.zh: 那特朗普总统呢？

sentences.en: What about President Trump?
sentences.zh: 我们在他2020年的音乐选择中看到了什么，能帮助我们理解他的策略以及他的竞选团队如何看待这些选民？

sentences.en: What do we see in his music selections this year, in 2020, that help us understand his strategy and how his campaign sees the strays?
sentences.zh: 在民主党候选人的集会上，音乐是序曲、前奏、配角。

sentences.en: At rallies for Democratic candidates, music is a prelude, a prologue, a sideshow.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的集会上，音乐是重头戏。

sentences.en: At Trump rallies, it is the main event.
sentences.zh: 它是人们等待集会开始时，将他们凝聚在一起数小时的纽带。

sentences.en: It is what ties them together for hours and hours as they wait for the rally to begin.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，它简直是你唯一能听到的东西。

sentences.en: And more so than that, it's just all you can hear.
sentences.zh: 它的播放音量震耳欲聋。

sentences.en: It's played at a deafening decibel level.
sentences.zh: 那不是为了让你在期间进行私下交谈而设计的。

sentences.en: That is not meant for you to have side conversations during.
sentences.zh: 你应该沉浸在音乐中。

sentences.en: You're supposed to be into the music.
sentences.zh: 这很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It's exciting.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普的集会上，你是为了他而来，但也是为了彼此而来。

sentences.en: At a Trump rally, you're there for him, but you're also there for each other.
sentences.zh: 有一种社区感，坦率地说，这在其他活动中是独一无二的。

sentences.en: And there is this kind of community feel that, frankly, is unique to those events.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人群中的舞蹈对决，那种大声的、声嘶力竭的合唱。

sentences.en: You know, dance battles in the crowd, kind of loud, top of your lungs singing.
sentences.zh: 你在特朗普集会上会听到《YMCA》。

sentences.en: You hear the YMCA at a Trump rally.
sentences.zh: 整个体育场的人会同时跳起来。

sentences.en: And the whole stadium will do it simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 当我们浏览特朗普的播放列表时，其中一些歌曲几乎已经成了总统本人的代名词，因为

sentences.en: And so as we look through the Trump playlist, some of these have become almost anonymous with the president himself because
sentences.zh: 他已经在这些备受瞩目的活动中使用了这些歌曲整整三年了。

sentences.en: he's been using these songs for now three years of what has been these intensely watch events.
sentences.zh: 林纳·史金纳乐队的《Sweet Home Alabama》。

sentences.en: Sweet Home Alabama by Leonard Skinner.
sentences.zh: 你有很多皇后乐队的歌，《Under Pressure》、《We Will Rock You》、《We Are the Champions》。

sentences.en: You have lots of songs by Queen, Under Pressure, We Will Rock You, We Are the Champions.
sentences.zh: 但你也有一些意想不到的曲目。

sentences.en: But you also have some maybe unexpected ones.
sentences.zh: 有波切利和席琳·迪翁的《The Prayer》。

sentences.en: You have The Prayer by Bocelli and Celine Dion.
sentences.zh: 有音乐剧《猫》中的《Memory》。

sentences.en: You have memories from the musical Cats.
sentences.zh: 你有猫。

sentences.en: You have cats.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你也有他在就职典礼上跳第一支舞时用的那首歌，

sentences.en: But, you know, you also have the same song he had his first dance to at inauguration,
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·辛纳屈的《My Way》。

sentences.en: My Way by Frank Sinatra.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是我的……

sentences.en: Yes, it was my...
sentences.zh: 你认为这种奇怪的音乐组合到底传达了什么信息？

sentences.en: What exactly is the message of this kind of strange mix of music, do you think?
sentences.zh: 我认为，通过歌词来建立某种内在联系是很难的。

sentences.en: It's, I think, kind of hard to create a connective tissue through the words and lyrics.
sentences.zh: 但你确实拥有的是，正如我们的分析所显示的，他拥有最大比例的白人艺术家和白人乐队。

sentences.en: But what you do have, and what our kind of analysis showed, is he had the largest majority of white artists and majority white bands.
sentences.zh: 而且他的播放列表也相当老派。我认为这两者的结合非常重要。

sentences.en: And he also has a pretty old playliSt. And I think the combo of those two things are really important.
sentences.zh: 这是白人怀旧情绪。

sentences.en: It's white nostalgia.
sentences.zh: 这是“让美国再次伟大”。

sentences.en: It's make America great again.
sentences.zh: 它唤起了一种对过去的怀念，但它仍然是体育场级别的音乐。

sentences.en: It is evoking a kind of feeling of the past, but it's still stadium music.
sentences.zh: 所以，它不是政治信息的音乐，它不是起义。

sentences.en: So rather than being the music of a political message, it's not uprising.
sentences.zh: 它不是女权主义。

sentences.en: It's not feminism.
sentences.zh: 它不是非裔美国人的身份认同。

sentences.en: It's not African-American identity.
sentences.zh: 它只是响亮、刺耳的美国式音乐。

sentences.en: It's just loud, blaring Americana.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个完美的描述。

sentences.en: I think that's a perfect description.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道特朗普总统是否听《猫》里的《Memory》。

sentences.en: We don't know if President Trump listens to Memories by Cats.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他是否像这个播放列表所反映的那样经常听皇后乐队的歌。

sentences.en: We don't know if he listens to Queen as much as this playlist reflects.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，他从人群的情绪中汲取力量，而且他热爱表演。

sentences.en: But what we do know about him is that he feeds off emotions from the crowd and that he loves a show.
sentences.zh: 这一点在观众进入体育场的那一刻就显而易见了。

sentences.en: And that is clear the second that audience gets in the stadium.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，对他来说，真实性并不是反映在歌词中，而是反映在现场的情绪中。

sentences.en: And so I would say the authenticity piece for him is not one that's reflected in the words of the songs, but is one that is in the emotion that's in the building.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们来看的表演者特质，他们为此感到兴奋，这就是他们得到的。

sentences.en: It's that showman quality that they've come to see, that they're excited to see, that's what they get.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论这些音乐是否真的符合特朗普平时的听歌品味，整个场景听起来都唤起了人们对他所代表立场的深刻共鸣。

sentences.en: So whether or not the music feels true to what Trump actually listens to, the whole scene, it sounds like, evokes a deep sense of what Trump stands for.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们一直提到的关于真实性的问题，

sentences.en: And it feels like this question, which we keep referring to, of authenticity,
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这一方面达到的程度，远超目前竞选对手所做的一切。

sentences.en: Trump achieves that on a kind of order of magnitude beyond what anyone else is currently doing on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，每位候选人都在试图向公众介绍自己，并从拥挤的民主党阵营中脱颖而出。

sentences.en: We know that each of the candidates is trying to introduce themselves to the public and to stand out from what is a crowded Democratic field.
sentences.zh: 而音乐是他们试图讲述那个故事的方式之一。

sentences.en: And music is one of the ways they try to tell that story.
sentences.zh: 当我想到特朗普集会上的那个场景，在演讲者开始之前，当人群在跳《YMCA》、做人浪和跳舞时，

sentences.en: When I think about this scene at Trump rallies, before the speakers begin, when the crowd is doing the YMCA and the wave and the dancing,
sentences.zh: 我认为那种能量中蕴含着真正的政治价值。

sentences.en: I think that there is actual political value in that energy.
sentences.zh: 无论谁在民主党方面胜出，都必须以一种能够匹配或超越那种能量水平的方式来激励他们的支持者。

sentences.en: And whoever wins on the Democratic side will have to motivate their base in a way that matches or exceeds that level of energy.
sentences.zh: 而且这必须以一种对那个人来说显得真实的方式来完成。

sentences.en: And it has to be done in a way that seems authentic to who that person is.
sentences.zh: 那绝非易事。

sentences.en: And that is not going to be an easy task.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: Well said.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.

sentences.zh: 特朗普政府周三公布了一项新规定，允许无限期拘留非法越境的移民家庭。

sentences.en: The Trump administration revealed a new regulation on Wednesday that would allow it to indefinitely detain migrant families who illegally cross the border.
sentences.zh: 该规定旨在取代一项已有数十年历史的法院协议，该协议限制了政府拘留移民儿童的时间。

sentences.en: The regulation is designed to replace a decades-old court agreement that limited how long the government could hold migrant children in custody.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾抱怨称，该裁决导致无证移民被释放到国内。

sentences.en: A ruling that Trump has complained allowed undocumented immigrants to be released into the country.
sentences.zh: 这一变更需要联邦法官的批准，预计将立即在法庭上受到挑战。

sentences.en: The change would require approval from a federal judge and is expected to be immediately challenged in court.

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。
